FAQ

Questions about mines & quarries software

Short, direct answers.

What does mining management software cover?

Production, dispatch, weighbridge, royalty and permits, fleet and fuel, stock, workforce and compliance. Sarvlekh connects these to remove paperwork and leakage.

Can it compute royalty automatically?

Yes. Royalty is computed from dispatch weight, grade and rate and matched with permits.

Does it work in remote locations?

Key apps work offline and sync when connectivity returns.

Can the mines & quarries system be customised to our way of working?

Yes. Every Sarvlekh system is shaped around your workflow — modules, roles, reports and approvals are configured with you, not imposed on you.

Can Sarvlekh connect the mines & quarries system to Tally and GST?

Yes. Sales, purchase and payment entries flow into Tally automatically and GST-ready invoices are generated from the same data.

How quickly can we go live?

A focused first release usually goes live in weeks. We start with the modules that remove the most manual work and expand in stages.
